text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Claw machines really are difficult, 
aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to apologize. 
Rather—stuffed animals and the like are 
unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let us head to the training 
grounds.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Now I'm really fired up. To think you'd 
give me this much trouble..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Without relying on things like plushies, I 
will crush them with these very legs of 
mine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
